title: oxybasis glauca subsp. ambigua
intro: Oxybasis glauca subsp. ambigua, commonly known as Chenopodium ambrosioides, is a plant species in the Amaranthaceae family. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Oxybasis glauca subsp. ambigua include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in relieving coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonene, camphor, and ascaridole, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
